DIAGNOSTICS BODY CONTROL SYSTEM
INSPECTION PROCEDURE
1 Check taillight relay (See page BE-17).
Replace the taillight relay. GI
2 Check wlreharness and connector between taillight relay and Body ECU, battery
and taillight relay (See page IN-30).
Repair or replace wlreharness or connector. G
Proceed to next circuit Inspection shown on
problem symptoms table (See page' ' ' D1-542).
